tha-ap197:1.1: Aṅkoḷaka.] Aṅkolaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā māhāsārasamotataṃ / ocinitvāna taṃ pupphaṃ agamaṃ Buddhasantike. // // Siddhattho
tha-ap197:2.1: tamhi samaye patilīno mahāmuni / muhuttaṃ patimānetvā guhāyaṃ puppham okiriṃ // //
tha-ap197:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap197:4.1: Chattiṃsamhi ito kappe ās' eko Devagajjito / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap197:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Aṅkolako thero i. g. a-ti.
